name: client-operations
description: Client reporting, quality assurance, and financial operations management. Handles KPI frameworks, compliance audits, budget tracking, launch checklists, and one written definition of CAC and payback. Use when: managing client dashboards, ensuring brand compliance, conducting QA reviews, tracking marketing spend, ensuring GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance, handling a request to delete someone's data across the marketing stack, deciding whether an AI voice or AI presenter has to be disclosed, proofreading deliverables. Also triggers on: client reporting, QA, brand compliance, marketing budget, CAC, CAC payback, why does our CAC not match finance, Magic Number, GDPR, CAN-SPAM, proofreading, launch checklist, right to erasure, DSAR, someone asked us to delete their data, do we delete or suppress, suppression list, they unsubscribed and we emailed them again, we deleted them and they came back, custom audience still has deleted contacts, California Delete Act
